
Acceptance criteria — record YOUR verdict on EACH id below with review_criterion. The forward move is refused while any id lacks your verdict on repositories that require criteria. Never move the task to need_revision just to look for these ids: they are here.
 A verdict already on an id survives a revision round — it is not asked again from zero. Where a line below names files changed since that verdict, re-verify and call review_criterion again only if one of those files could plausibly affect that specific criterion; leave the rest as they are. An id with no verdict yet still needs one.
